_comment: Declarative Thunderbird tag definitions. bin/omarchy-thunderbird-apply renders
these into the profile's user.js as mailnews.tags.<key>.{tag,color} prefs, so the
tag set is configuration rather than something clicked together in the UI.
key must be [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ and unique; color must be a 6-digit hex.
The 'suspicious' tag is applied by the guard extension when it flags a message.
